title: G&T-Seq
scope: Illumina explanatory G&T-seq schematic: single-cell isolation and lysis, poly(A)-RNA bead capture, physical RNA/DNA separation, Smart-seq2 transcriptome amplification and MDA genome amplification, then sequencing and same-cell alignment/integration. G&T-Seq and G&T-seq are capitalization aliases. The left overview is explanatory. scM&T-seq is a separately supported related extension used to delimit the shared separation interface, not an alias or a depicted bisulfite branch. The card's general whole-genome-amplification compatibility statement does not define additional concrete variants here.

operations.label: Isolate single cell

operations.label: Lyse cell
operations.description: Disrupt the isolated cell to make its RNA and DNA accessible together in a lysate.
operations.information_effect: Changes cellular containment to a shared lysate while retaining the origin in one cell.

operations.label: Streptavidin magnetic bead with mRNA capture primer
operations.description: Use the bead-tethered capture primer to bind the depicted RNA poly(A) tract; DNA remains outside the RNA-primer-bead complex in the mixture.
operations.mechanism: Oligo(dT)/poly(A) hybridization captures RNA; biotinylated primer attaches through streptavidin-coated magnetic beads. The bead/primer is a capture reagent retained with RNA, not an enzyme or independent sample.
operations.information_effect: Selects poly(A)-bearing RNA and supplies a physical handle for separating this selected transcript fraction from genomic DNA.

evidence.locator: Streptavidin magnetic bead with mRNA capture primer: purple RNA A-tail paired to T tract; green tether to blue bead attachment; blue DNA below

operations.label: Separate the DNA and the RNA
operations.description: Physically divide the capture mixture into the retained bead-bound RNA fraction and the separate genomic DNA fraction.
operations.mechanism: The streptavidin magnetic bead provides the physical RNA-fraction handle; DNA follows the distinct lower branch.
operations.information_effect: Retains both same-cell analytes on separate routes so each can be amplified independently. Separation does not create a DNA-RNA chimera or a shared molecular tag.

operations.label: On-bead transcriptome amplification with Smart-seq2
operations.description: Process captured bead-bound RNA through the broad Smart-seq2 transcriptome-amplification block, yielding amplified transcript-derived material for sequencing. operations.mechanism: Smart-seq2 is named; its internal reaction sequence is not supplied by the drawing or the available G&T-seq abstract.
operations.information_effect: Transfers captured mRNA sequence information into an amplified RNA-derived DNA carrier for the transcriptome readout; the on-bead label is retained without asserting that every downstream product remains attached.

method_scopes.rationale: All operations belong to the single G&T-seq workflow actually depicted; Smart-seq2 and MDA name its two amplification blocks, not independent aliases of G&T-seq. The primary G&T-seq abstract supports the paired full-length mRNA/genome target; detailed block names come from the image/card. Related scM&T-seq shares physical separation as explicitly reported but replaces the genomic readout with scBS-seq, so the depicted MDA operation is not assigned to it.
